page.overview:
Who is Flex?

Flex, also known as Migh in Germany and Aркан (Arkan, "Lasso") in Russia, is an Alpha Team minifigure first introduced in a 2000 video game before making a physical debut in 2001.

In 5714 LEGO Alpha Team, Flex wears the general black jumpsuit with an Alpha Team globe insignia on his left torso. He has an orange stripe from his right shoulder down to his right leg, matching his bright orange bright sleeve. He has ropes slung across his torso, from his right shoulder to his left hip, representing his expertise. On his belt, he has three grey capsules and two pouches. He also has two pockets on his thighs and a kneepad directly below. His gloves are grey. He wears a black Flying Helmet that is modified with extra textures and a ring for attaching rope to Flex's Helmet Dangler. His face bears a very large open-mouthed smile and a comm headset.

In 2001, Flex's physical minifigure very closely resembles his video game design, albeit with simpler details on the ropes and capsules as well as an unmodified Flying Helmet.

In Mission Deep Sea, Flex's minifigure wears an almost identical outfit, but in earth blue instead of black. Instead of rope, he now wears what appears to be a sort of industrial wire across his chest. As with other Alpha Team agents, his hip and leg printing has been updated to match the style of the Mission Deep Sea uniform, eschewing the pockets and kneepads in favor of orange and grey striping. His Flying Helmet has been replaced with a dark grey Mini Crash Helmet with a transparent blue Divers Mask and a dark grey Oxygenbottle With Tube. His face printing slightly shrinks his smile and gives him visible orange/silver hair, with bangs extending over his right eye.
